name: list_skill_resources
description: List bundled resource files for an installed skill package (references/examples/scripts). Use proactively after `load_skill` to discover what reference material is available.

category.description: Optional filter: 'references', 'examples', or 'scripts'. When omitted, all bundled resources are listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of files to list (default: 100, max: 500).
